name: GPT Image GIFs
tagline: Turn text or a reference image into looping AI GIFs: stickers, reactions and pixel art. Watermark-free downloads, private to your account.
description: GPT Image GIFs turns a text prompt or one reference image into a looping animated GIF. Set style, quality, 6 to 16 frames, size from 512x512 to 960x960 and playback speed, then download the GIF with no watermark. Prompts and files stay private to your account. Browsing examples is free; verified accounts may claim a one-time grant of 4 free credits, and more credits are sold as one-time packs from US $9.90 with no subscription. Independent service, not affiliated with OpenAI.
